summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload under it
details: @servicetitan/eh-module-communication@0.2.4 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is written in obfuscator.io-style (`_0x...` identifiers, string-array indirection) and fetches the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unpacks it to a temp directory, makes it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the package's own `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 720KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with a classic string-array + array-shuffler obfuscation scheme (`WV8StW` shuffler, `n7gIxM` numeric table, `hc1jfK9` charset decoder). The package presents itself as a shared communication registry module but has no source-visible reason to bundle a large obfuscated blob or to require a second language runtime at install time; the alternate-runtime execution path (Bun instead of Node) evades Node-based supply-chain inspection while running attacker-authored code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. The bundle's Bun-only compatibility and the obfuscation together prevent any inspection of what the payload actually does on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
